title: Desktop Agents
description: Use supported AI agents already installed and signed in on this computer. By default, Desktop Agents ask before running elevated actions in Space conversations.
detectionBoundary: Checks command availability only; sign-in and ACP connectivity are not verified.

executableCli.title: Direct ACP
executableCli.requirements: Install an official CLI with ACP support and add its command directory to PATH.

nodeAdapter.title: ACP adapter
nodeAdapter.requirements: Requires the official CLI and Node.js (npx). First use may download the ACP adapter.

standaloneServer.title: Standalone ACP server
standaloneServer.requirements: Download the official ACP archive, keep its companion files, and add the server directory to PATH.

trustedMode.label: Trusted mode (unattended full access)
trustedMode.description: Skip permission prompts and allow this agent to run commands and edit files automatically. Only enable if you trust every source in your Spaces.
trustedMode.confirmDescription: Trusted mode switches this Desktop Agent to full-access execution and automatically approves its permission requests without confirmation. Untrusted web pages or files in a Space could trigger unintended commands.
